input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, placed behind live 6x5 reels and interactive controls
Primary request: create one entirely original AURUM FORGE luxury casino slot machine, a monumental magical gold foundry where molten treasure is minted, with a very large clean rectangular reel aperture for a six-column five-row cluster-tumble game and a compact integrated control deck
Scene/backdrop: a sophisticated emerald-glass and champagne-gold foundry hall, symmetrical art-deco furnace architecture, subtle flowing molten-gold channels along the sides, gemstone pressure gauges, restrained coin-mint mechanisms and warm depth; no royal palace, crown, wheel, throne or reused vintage cabinet motifs
Subject: one front-facing integrated slot stage with a blank engraved title crest at top, a compact blank balance capsule below it, one dominant empty reel aperture occupying most of the middle 58 percent of the composition, a slim horizontal forge-energy meter socket directly below the reels, and a shallow compact control deck with left minus/plus recesses, one large central spin recess and one right auto recess; lower pedestal short and unobtrusive
Style/medium: high-end commercial 3D mobile casino game art, polished stylized realism, crisp physical materials and coherent built-in UI architecture
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, exact orthographic front view, perfectly centered and symmetrical, all edges inside safe area, reel aperture broad and tall with straight undistorted edges, controls visibly belong to the machine, no detached floating panels
Lighting/mood: warm controlled furnace light, refined champagne reflections, saturated emerald glass accents, bright readable center, restrained bloom, premium casino excitement
Color palette: champagne gold, pale molten gold, deep emerald, ivory enamel, small ruby and cyan gemstone accents; avoid dominant burgundy, purple, black or brown
Materials/textures: brushed and polished gold, emerald glass, pale stone enamel, engraved metal, faceted gemstones, warm bulbs
Text: none
Constraints: completely blank title crest, blank balance capsule, empty dark-emerald reel opening with no reels or symbols, empty energy-meter socket, clearly defined control recesses; no letters, numbers, currency marks, logos, watermark, characters, crown, fortune wheel, lower bonus wheel, S07 composition, black rectangles, black drop-shadow boxes or red flash
Avoid: copied casino cabinet, royal throne room, wheel-of-fortune layout, narrow reel screen, oversized lower body, detached stickers, flat vector art, sci-fi neon, illegible markings, heavy shadows, overexposed glare
